After you pause, a model suggests a change near the cursor, such as the same rename in the next place. Tab accepts, Esc dismisses. Each suggestion is a request to a model, at most 20 a minute; the code around the cursor and your last few edits are sent to it. ::: 你停顿后，模型会在光标附近建议一处修改，比如在下一个位置做同样的重命名。按 Tab 接受，按 Esc 忽略。每条建议都是对模型的一次请求，每分钟最多 20 次；光标周围的代码和你最近的几次编辑会发送给它。
